_formato: Properties of the background gas of the case, read by the simulator (dbd1d/modelo.py).
fundo: species of kinet.inp that form the background gas and their fractions.
cv_por_kb: specific heat at constant volume per heavy particle, in units of k_B (1.5 for a monatomic gas, 2.5 for a diatomic one without vibration).

condutividade: thermal conductivity in W/(m K); tipo linear_com_raiz, (a T + b) escala, times (T/t_raiz)^(1/2) above t_raiz, or tipo tabela, with T (K) and kappa, interpolated linearly and clamped at the ends.
ion_inicial: positive ion seeded with the electrons in the neutral initial plasma.
calor (optional): enthalpies in eV per particle, for the heat of each reaction (-sum of nu h), and processos_rapidos, BOLSIG+ processes whose energy becomes gas heat within picoseconds.
The fonte fields are only a record of the source.
fonte: N2:H2 1:1 mixture of Sun et al. 2022

conductivity of the 1:1 mixture by kinetic theory (Cantera 3.2, Mason and Saxena mixing with the GRI-Mech 3.0 parameters); the pure gases agree with the references (N2 0.0263 against 0.0260 W/(m K) at 300 K, Engineering ToolBox; H2 0.187 against about 0.182)
cv of a diatomic gas without vibration, 2.5 k_B; the vibration of N2 and H2 is in the vibrational species of the mechanism
no calor block for now (enthalpies of the 38 species not yet compiled)
